title: Tenant reserve health dashboard - contract-level view (Nov 2027)
summary: One-page operational dashboard summarizing per-contract reserved GPU health, short-term utilization trends, and 90-day breach probability estimates. Purpose: give SRE/Capacity SMEs a prioritized list of contracts requiring intervention before the next capacity sync. Data window: most metrics are rolling 30-day unless otherwise noted.
interpretation: AtlasPay: sustained 30-day utilization at 81% with active allocation nearing reserved + projected growth — recommended immediate capacity review and negotiation for +15–20 GPU top-up or enable burst policy.

HelixMed: healthy buffer today but 90-day projection shows decline in active allocation due to scheduled model decommission (HELIX-archive). Risk moderate; monitor weekly and confirm model decommission timeline.

VespucciAnalytics: large contract with seasonal spikes. Current buffer adequate but projection approaches reserved capacity; suggest pre-authorized temporary burst window during forecasted spike weeks.
NimbusEdge: underutilized in region; candidate for soft rebalancing (move up to 10 GPUs to higher-risk tenants) after confirming latency SLAs with customer.

TheraLabs: flat-out at 100% 30-day utilization and zero buffer. High probability of SLA breach if any unexpected load; urgent mitigation required (either increase reservation or apply throttled fallback to non-dedicated pool).
action_items: [SRE] Open top-up negotiation ticket for AtlasPay (JIRA:INFRA-5721) and propose interim burst allocation of 20 GPUs for 6 weeks.
[Capacity PM] Confirm HelixMed model archive schedule and update projection model by 2027-11-20.
[Sales Ops] Contact VespucciAnalytics to propose seasonal burst add-on; draft proposal by 2027-11-15.
[Infra Ops] Create rebalancing playbook for NimbusEdge candidate GPUs; validate latency impacts with Solutions Eng before reassignment.
[Account Manager] Escalate TheraLabs SLA exposure and request expedited contract amendment or activate emergency burst credits.
[All] Weekly sync on Monday 09:00 PST during November to track metrics and ticket status.
assumptions: All utilization figures are 30-day moving averages computed from telemetry pipeline v2.1.
90-day projections assume linear growth based on last 30 days unless a schedule (decommission or planned scale) is present.
Buffer = Reserved GPUs - Active Alloc (live attached GPUs).
Burst capacity is available up to 10% of regional spare pool unless otherwise committed by reserved contracts.
calculations: 90d Projection = Active Alloc + (Active Alloc * 0.15) // default growth assumption if no schedule
Breach Probability heuristic: High if Utilization >= 85% or Buffer <= 10 and projection > Reserved; Medium if Utilization 60-85%; Low otherwise.
provenance_notes: Metrics pulled from telemetry-export v2 (s3://telemetry/exports/capacity/2027-11-09.csv). Contract metadata joined from crm-contracts service snapshot taken 2027-11-08. Manual checks performed for AtlasPay and TheraLabs allocation anomalies.
